blocks.html: CDN = Content Delivery Network = Distributed system of servers deployed across multiple geographical locations.
blocks.text: CDN = Content Delivery Network = Distributed system of servers deployed across multiple geographical locations.

blocks.html: Primary purpose: Deliver digital content with high availability, performance, and scalability.
blocks.text: Primary purpose: Deliver digital content with high availability, performance, and scalability.

blocks.html: Core Concepts
blocks.text: Core Concepts

blocks.html: Origin server: Central server where original content is hosted.
blocks.text: Origin server: Central server where original content is hosted.

blocks.html: Edge servers / PoPs (Points of Presence): Geographically distributed servers that cache and serve content closer to users.
blocks.text: Edge servers / PoPs (Points of Presence): Geographically distributed servers that cache and serve content closer to users.

blocks.html: Caching: Storing frequently accessed data temporarily to reduce load and latency.
blocks.text: Caching: Storing frequently accessed data temporarily to reduce load and latency.

blocks.html: Request routing: Mechanism to decide which edge server serves a client request
blocks.text: Request routing: Mechanism to decide which edge server serves a client request

blocks.html: How CDN Works (Workflow)
blocks.text: How CDN Works (Workflow)

blocks.html: User requests content (e.g., website).
blocks.text: User requests content (e.g., website).

blocks.html: Request is routed to most optimal edge server (based on routing strategy).
blocks.text: Request is routed to most optimal edge server (based on routing strategy).

blocks.html: If cached copy available → served immediately.
blocks.text: If cached copy available → served immediately.

blocks.html: If not cached → edge server fetches from origin → serves to client → caches it for future.
blocks.text: If not cached → edge server fetches from origin → serves to client → caches it for future.

blocks.html: Benefits
blocks.text: Benefits

blocks.html: Reduced latency: Content delivered from nearest location.
blocks.text: Reduced latency: Content delivered from nearest location.

blocks.html: Lower bandwidth consumption: Cached assets reduce repeated origin fetches.
blocks.text: Lower bandwidth consumption: Cached assets reduce repeated origin fetches.

blocks.html: High availability: Load distributed across multiple servers.
blocks.text: High availability: Load distributed across multiple servers.

blocks.html: Scalability: Handles traffic spikes.
blocks.text: Scalability: Handles traffic spikes.

blocks.html: Security: All user requests first hit the CDN edge servers, not your main server, so lots of filtering can be done here (TLS, DDoS, Bot Mitigation, WAF, Rate Limiting etc).
blocks.text: Security: All user requests first hit the CDN edge servers, not your main server, so lots of filtering can be done here (TLS, DDoS, Bot Mitigation, WAF, Rate Limiting etc).

blocks.html: Caching Strategies
blocks.text: Caching Strategies

blocks.html: Time-to-Live (TTL): Duration content is cached before revalidation.
blocks.text: Time-to-Live (TTL): Duration content is cached before revalidation.

blocks.html: Cache Invalidation: Removing outdated or incorrect cache.
blocks.text: Cache Invalidation: Removing outdated or incorrect cache.

blocks.html: Stale-while-revalidate: Serve stale cache while refreshing in background.
blocks.text: Stale-while-revalidate: Serve stale cache while refreshing in background.

blocks.html: Stale-if-error: Serve stale cache if origin unavailable.
blocks.text: Stale-if-error: Serve stale cache if origin unavailable.

blocks.html: Types of Content Served
blocks.text: Types of Content Served

blocks.html: Static content: Images, scripts, stylesheets.
blocks.text: Static content: Images, scripts, stylesheets.

blocks.html: Dynamic content: Personalized or user-specific data (can be optimized with edge computation).
blocks.text: Dynamic content: Personalized or user-specific data (can be optimized with edge computation).

blocks.html: Streaming content: Video-on-demand (VoD), live streaming with chunked delivery.
blocks.text: Streaming content: Video-on-demand (VoD), live streaming with chunked delivery.

blocks.html: APIs: REST, GraphQL served via CDN with caching or edge logic.

blocks.html: Request Routing Techniques
blocks.text: Request Routing Techniques

blocks.html: GeoDNS: DNS directs user to closest server.
blocks.text: GeoDNS: DNS directs user to closest server.

blocks.html: Load-based routing: Directs traffic to servers with available capacity.
blocks.text: Load-based routing: Directs traffic to servers with available capacity.

blocks.html: Latency-based routing: Chooses server with lowest measured latency.
blocks.text: Latency-based routing: Chooses server with lowest measured latency.

blocks.html: Anycast: Same IP advertised from multiple locations; network routes to nearest.
blocks.text: Anycast: Same IP advertised from multiple locations; network routes to nearest.

blocks.html: CDN Architectures
blocks.text: CDN Architectures

blocks.html: Push CDN: Content uploaded to CDN nodes proactively.
blocks.text: Push CDN: Content uploaded to CDN nodes proactively.

blocks.html: Pull CDN: Content fetched from origin on first request (lazy population).
blocks.text: Pull CDN: Content fetched from origin on first request (lazy population).

blocks.html: Hybrid: Combination of push and pull.
blocks.text: Hybrid: Combination of push and pull.

blocks.html: CDN Challenges
blocks.text: CDN Challenges

blocks.html: Cache consistency: Ensuring updated content reaches all edges.
blocks.text: Cache consistency: Ensuring updated content reaches all edges.

blocks.html: Dynamic personalization: Harder to cache user-specific data.
blocks.text: Dynamic personalization: Harder to cache user-specific data.

blocks.html: Invalidation delays: Some cached objects may remain stale.
blocks.text: Invalidation delays: Some cached objects may remain stale.

blocks.html: Latency in routing decisions: DNS-based routing may not always pick optimal node.
blocks.text: Latency in routing decisions: DNS-based routing may not always pick optimal node.
